# Voicy

> Free, open-source AI speech enhancement for Apple Silicon Macs. A local Adobe Podcast alternative. Audio is processed on the user's Mac, with no account or audio upload.

## Current availability
Downloads are temporarily paused as of 15 October 2026: the published 0.3.2 native launcher times out because it expects an older backend version. A source fix is being tested; a signed replacement has not been published. The prerecorded website demo remains available.

## Product
- [Adobe Podcast alternative comparison](https://usevoicy.app/adobe-podcast-alternative): sourced feature comparison, audio samples, requirements, limitations, and alternatives by workflow. Written by the Voicy project, not an independent review.
- [Home and audible demo](https://usevoicy.app/): overview, prerecorded original/enhanced comparison, requirements, and FAQ.
- [Download status](https://usevoicy.app/api/download): current availability; downloads paused pending a verified startup fix.
- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/jindratilk/voicy): MIT application code, build instructions, model licenses, limitations.
- [Privacy](https://usevoicy.app/privacy): local processing and aggregate website statistics.

## Accurate facts
Voicy uses Tencent AuK with 32 solver steps, executed through MLX/Metal. It requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. The download is approximately 6.5 GB with models included, and the full installed app needs approximately 8 GB; 16 GB of memory or more is recommended. There is no fixed recording-duration or file-size cap. Processing capacity depends on available memory and disk space. Exports are mono 48 kHz PCM24 WAV, from a model operating at 24 kHz. Processing is not real time. Generative enhancement can alter voice texture or words. The original is preserved. Results vary. Voicy is independent and is not affiliated with Adobe or Apple. Application source is MIT; dependencies and models retain their own licenses. Voicy does not claim objective superiority over Adobe Podcast or universal quality improvements.
